Tourists consuming trauma. Sigrid remembering. Family preserved. Audience witnessing. All one witness. Fragmented but whole. The cracks spread. More perspectives. Vikings seeing future. Children unborn watching back. The obelisk in all fragments. The constant. The monument to transformation. Standing in all times. Witnessed by all eyes. The crack patterns form shape: raven wings. The witness fractures into flight pattern. Ready to break apart. To become many. To spread the story.
